contexts.text: From the gesture... of another, it is known what he is thinking.
A gesture naturally flowing from humiliation. AC 4215:2.
All interior affections have gestures corresponding to them... which gestures are the effects of the affections. Example(s).
Celestial good and spiritual good do not laugh, but express their delight and cheerfulness in the face, speech, and gesture.
Bowing is a gesture of both humiliation and joy.

The things which take place by gestures in the body... take place according to the things which the man is thinking and willing... The very gestures and actions... represent the things which are of the mind, and are representations; and as they are in accordance, they are correspondences. AC 2989.
Man's speech and gesture are images of the things which come forth within him... so that speech and gesture are the thought and the will in form.
Interior affection falls into any gesture; for to every affection there are gestures in the body which correspond.
There is also a correspondence of the thoughts and affections with the actions and gestures of the body.
With those who are in evil and thence in falsity, there is no longer any general involuntary sense which manifests itself either in face, speech, or gesture; but it is voluntary...
They put on most friendly... gestures.
Decorum is to testify this by speech and gesture...
There is then no longer anything honourable in the speech and in the gestures.

All the endeavours of the Internal which are of the will... have external acts or gestures which correspond to them. These acts or gestures flow from the very correspondence of exterior things with interior ones. Example(s).
The gestures and motions which are put on, are nothing but things added, which cause the will to appear and affect in a suitable manner.
It is then a gesture without genuine affection producing it...
Every spiritual affection has a gesture in man's body which corresponds to it, which gesture is the representative of it. Example(s).

To expand the palms is of gesture or action, which corresponds to supplication of heart. There are gestures or actions of the body which correspond to every affection of the mind. Example(s)... In the Word, these gestures or actions signify the affections themselves to which they correspond, because they represent them.
Worship without (humiliation and submission) is... only a gesture in imitation of those who are in true worship; in which gesture there is nothing of life...
From their faces, speech, and gestures... it is clearly perceived what their quality is as to love.
There is also a speech by gestures which correspond to the affections...
[Swedenborg footnote 1.]. That thought falls into speech, and will into gestures according to general influx. References.
The exteriors of the spirit are those by which it accommodates... the face, speech, and gestures.
The quality of a Spirit is at once Known... also from the speech and gestures.
(Thus) the internal lies hidden interiorly in the tone, speech, face, and gesture of the External...
(The male and female) differ also in gestures and manners. CL 218, Described.
From the tone they perceive the affection of his thought; and from the gesture or form of the action, the love of his will.
When they are commanded to gesticulate...
(I said that) affections are attended with gestures, which are as it were their bodies. Example(s).
(The magicians) observe that certain things in the World of Spirits correspond to such gestures...
The magicians... knew how to make many gesticulations (enumerated.), by means of which they obtained influx and communication...
There are, from creation, gestures which correspond to every affection, and man falls spontaneously into them when he comes into the affection. Example(s).
